function.name: nik_parse
function.description: Parse an Indonesian NIK locally. The returned NIK is masked.

nik.description: NIK value. Never include it in messages, logs, or artifacts unless explicitly necessary.

function.name: nik_validate
function.description: Perform concise local structural NIK validation. This is not official Dukcapil verification.

nik.description: NIK value. Never include it in messages, logs, or artifacts unless explicitly necessary.

function.name: nik_detect_crop
function.description: Detect a candidate NIK crop in an authorized image file. No image or crop is stored.

path.description: Path to an image in this agent's attachments or artifacts directory.

function.name: nik_image_crop
function.description: Crop a geometric NIK, portrait, signature, or custom region from an authorized image. No image or crop is stored.

path.description: Path to an authorized image attachment or artifact.

function.name: nik_extract_from_image
function.description: Extract a NIK from an authorized image after crop detection, using disabled, offline OCR, or an explicitly selected Evonic vision model.

path.description: Path to an image in this agent's attachments or artifacts directory.

vision_model_id.description: Enabled vision-capable Evonic model ID, required only for vision_model.
